verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a virtual mailbox provider, so guided USPS Form 1583 completion is an applicable axis. The evidence pack never mentions Form 1583, online notarization, or ID requirements. The 'pre-filled templates' are for changing registered agents, and 'Fully remote setup' refers to TruResidence, so neither covers the CMRA Form 1583 process.

support.subject: As a founder, I can complete USPS Form 1583 with guided help — pre-filled forms, online notarization, and clear ID requirements — instead of deciphering the CMRA process alone
